name: job-hunt
description: UK-first job-hunt skill: build a master profile from a dump folder, tailor ATS-safe CVs to a job description, source live roles across connectors, write cover letters, and track every application. The profile is a decoupled data feed — swap the path for anyone.

reed_api_key.title: Reed API key
reed_api_key.description: Optional. Reed.co.uk Jobseeker API key (free at reed.co.uk/developers). Enables the bundled Reed job-search connector. Leave blank to skip Reed — sourcing falls back to web search.

adzuna_app_id.title: Adzuna app id
adzuna_app_id.description: Optional. Adzuna app_id (free at developer.adzuna.com). Needed with the app key for the bundled Adzuna connector.

adzuna_app_key.title: Adzuna app key
adzuna_app_key.description: Optional. Adzuna app_key that pairs with the app id for the bundled Adzuna connector.

firecrawl_api_key.title: Firecrawl API key
firecrawl_api_key.description: Optional. Firecrawl API key (fc-... , free tier at firecrawl.dev). Enables full job-description crawling. Leave blank to fall back to WebSearch/WebFetch.
